title: "variance partition analysis - glia"
output: html_document

```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(doParallel)
library(variancePartition)
library("limma")
library("edgeR")

set.seed(1)


#Generate cell metadata from animal-level metadata, animal-level characteristics, and cluster assignments. Perform testing and evaluation on each cell class separately.

#clean animal metadata
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../shared objs and code/YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)
#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)


#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]


#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

animal_metadata$age = factor(animal_metadata$age, levels = c("young","old"))


#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")

#Combine and add metadata

#append neuronal to non neuronal
cluster_assignments = c(non_neuronal_cluster_assignments, neuronal_cluster_assignments)

#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
df_internal_and_official_name = read_csv("../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% mutate(cluster = case_when(
  cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id ~ df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(cluster, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)],
  .default = cluster
))
cell_metadata$cluster = as.factor(cell_metadata$cluster)

#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

#Remove the single animal w/o CFC/CFA measurements (could be potential confound)
animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm = animal_metadata %>% filter(is.na(CFM) | is.na(CFA)) %>% pull(animal_id) %>% unique %>% as.character
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)

#identify animals with less than 1000 cells and remove them from dataset (low number of cells for an animal may throw off proportions)
animals_less_1000_cells = cell_metadata$animal_id %>% table %>% .[. < 1000] %>% names
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% droplevels()

# add cell class
cell_metadata =cell_metadata %>% mutate(cell_class = case_when(
  cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$official_name ~ "neuronal",#neuronal
  .default = sub("[-_].*", "", cluster) #non-neuronal
)) 
cell_metadata$cell_class = as.factor(cell_metadata$cell_class)
#Identify classes with only one cluster and remove from proportion analysis, since we do it by class - removed tcells, bam
classes_one_cluster = cell_metadata %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(cluster, cell_class) %>% ungroup() %>% count(cell_class) %>% filter(n == 1) %>% pull(cell_class)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!cell_class %in% classes_one_cluster) %>% droplevels()
#add "animal_" to animal_id column to avoid problems with sccomp, and convert to factor; and do same for animal_metadata
cell_metadata$animal_id = paste0("animal_",cell_metadata$animal_id) %>% as.factor() 
animal_metadata$animal_id = paste0("animal_",animal_metadata$animal_id) %>% as.factor()

#split neuronal into gabaergic or glutamatergic cell classes based on 25% expression, remove sole cluster that's both 
aggregate_percent_exp = readRDS("../shared objs and code/aggregate_percent_neuronal.rds")
aggregate_percent_exp = aggregate_percent_exp %>% as.data.frame()
aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut = aggregate_percent_exp[c("Slc32a1","Slc17a6"),]

aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut = aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>% pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "percent_exp") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = percent_exp)
aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut = aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut %>% mutate(neuronal_type = case_when(
  Slc32a1 > .25 & Slc17a6 < .25 ~ "Gabaergic",
  Slc32a1 < .25 & Slc17a6 > .25 ~ "Glutamatergic",
  Slc32a1 > .25 & Slc17a6 >= .25 ~ "Neuronal - Both",
  .default = NA
))

cell_metadata$neuronal_type = aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut$neuronal_type[match(cell_metadata$cluster, aggregate_percent_exp_gaba_glut$cluster)]
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(neuronal_type != "Neuronal - Both" | is.na(neuronal_type))
# Split the cluster assignments into a list by cell class to loop over
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% mutate(cell_class = case_when(
  neuronal_type == "Glutamatergic" ~ "Glutamatergic",
  neuronal_type == "Gabaergic" ~ "Gabaergic",
.default = cell_class #non-neuronal classes
 ))

cluster_list <- split(cell_metadata, cell_metadata$cell_class)

all_ge = open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
genes_to_remove <- rownames(all_ge)[grepl("^Gm|Rik", rownames(all_ge))]
all_ge = all_ge[!rownames(all_ge) %in% genes_to_remove, ]

library(variancePartition)
variance_partition_formula = ~ (1|strain) + (1|sex) + (1|genotype) + (1|age)

class_list <- c("VLMC","astrocyte","ependymal","microglia","olig","opc","tanycyte","vascular", "Gabaergic", "Glutamatergic")

all_results <- list()
cl <- makeCluster(8)
registerDoParallel(cl)


#helper function - select top 5000 variable genes as subset
get_var_genes_from_counts = function(initial_ge_matrix, n_var_genes = 5000) {
  initial_ge_matrix <- multiply_cols(initial_ge_matrix, 1/Matrix::colSums(initial_ge_matrix))
  initial_ge_matrix <- log1p(initial_ge_matrix * 1e4) # Log transform
  variable_genes <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(initial_ge_matrix, nfeatures = n_var_genes) 
  variable_genes = variable_genes %>% filter(variable == T) 
  rownames(variable_genes)
}
```


```{r}
for (cur_class in class_list) {
    # Filter metadata for current cell class
    cur_meta <- cell_metadata %>%
      filter(cell_class == cur_class) %>%
      droplevels()
    
    # Subset gene expression matrix to these cells
    cur_ge_subset <- all_ge[, cur_meta$cell_id]
    
    #get var genes and subset
    var_genes = get_var_genes_from_counts(cur_ge_subset)
    cur_ge_subset = cur_ge_subset[var_genes,]
    
    # Pseudobulk expression per animal/cell class (could also use mean)
    cur_pb <- pseudobulk_matrix(cur_ge_subset, cell_groups = cur_meta$animal_id, method = "sum")
    
    # Create pseudobulk metadata df with matching columns
    pb_meta <- cur_meta %>%
      select(animal_id, strain, sex, genotype, age, cell_class) %>% 
      distinct() %>%
      as.data.frame()
    rownames(pb_meta) <- pb_meta$animal_id
    pb_meta <- pb_meta[colnames(cur_pb), ]

  #normalize via log1p cpm normalization
  cur_pb =  multiply_cols(cur_pb, 1/Matrix::colSums(cur_pb))
  cur_pb <- log1p(cur_pb * 1e6)
  # Run variancePartition analysis
  varPart <- fitExtractVarPartModel(cur_pb, variance_partition_formula, pb_meta)
  varPart$class = cur_class
  all_results[[cur_class]][["variance_df"]] = varPart %>%  as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("gene") 
  all_results[[cur_class]][["norm_exp_data"]] = cur_pb
  all_results[[cur_class]][["pb_meta"]] = pb_meta %>% mutate(class = cur_class)
}
saveRDS(all_results,"all_results_var_partition_analysis.rds")
```
